verdicts.reason: The account holds Rs 175,908.82 of the victim's traced funds—97% of the disputed amount—easily exceeding the 25% threshold. The lien freezes only 0.19% of the account's Rs 9.28 crore balance, so the customer retains virtually all of their own money, and the high pass-through ratio (6.34), 10 device-sharing accounts, 15 phone-sharing accounts, and involvement in 3 related cases support the hold.
